checks.explanation: The US equity market bottomed around October 2023 and rallied materially higher through 2024 despite interest rates remaining elevated.
The US avoided a recession (a soft landing), and the Federal Reserve began cutting interest rates starting in September 2024.
Ripple did secure a partial win against the SEC and broader crypto litigation against the SEC increased, but a clean "wave of counter-lawsuits" as specifically framed is a stretch.
Some crypto companies did shift toward fighting SEC actions in court, but others continued to settle; not a clean industry-wide shift.
Similar mixed evidence: some crypto-sector M&A-adjacent SEC disputes were litigated rather than settled, but not uniformly across the sector.
The US Army significantly ramped 155mm artillery shell production toward roughly 100,000 rounds per month by around 2025, closely matching the predicted trajectory and timeframe.
The 2023 Atlantic hurricane season was above-average (20 named storms) but was not the most active on record; that record remains 2020 with 30 named storms.
